# M0-S2: loGo/s and Go code do not import each other; workspaces hold both kinds.
# Each case uses a distinct fixture so an earlier diagnostic cannot mask a later one.

env GOPROXY=off

# loGo/s package importing a Go package fails.
cd w1/l
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::logos_imports_go\] loGo/s package example\.com/l/p imports Go package example\.com/g/q; loGo/s and Go code do not import each other'
cd ../..

# Go package importing a loGo/s package fails (reverse direction).
cd w2/g
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::go_imports_logos\] Go package example\.com/g/q imports loGo/s package example\.com/l/p'
cd ../..

# loGo/s package importing only the standard library builds and runs.
cd std
logos build ./...
logos run .
stdout 'std-ok'
cd ..

# A module holding one Go package and one loGo/s package fails.
cd mixedmod
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example\.com/m has Go packages \(example\.com/m/a\) and loGo/s packages \(example\.com/m/b\)'
cd ..

# A workspace with independent Go and loGo/s modules builds from the root; both binaries run.
cd ws
logos build ./...
mkdir $WORK/wsbin
logos build -o $WORK/wsbin/gohello$GOEXE ./gomod
logos build -o $WORK/wsbin/lgohello$GOEXE ./lgomod
exec $WORK/wsbin/gohello$GOEXE
stdout 'go-ok'
exec $WORK/wsbin/lgohello$GOEXE
stdout 'lgo-ok'

-- w1/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w1/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

require example.com/g v0.0.0

replace example.com/g => ../g

-- w1/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

import _ "example.com/g/q"

-- w1/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w1/g/q/q.go --
package q

func Q() int { return 1 }

-- w2/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w2/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w2/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

func P() int { return 1 }

-- w2/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

require example.com/l v0.0.0

replace example.com/l => ../l

-- w2/g/q/q.go --
package q

import _ "example.com/l/p"

-- std/go.mod --
module example.com/std

go 1.27

-- std/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	_ = context.Background()
	fmt.Println("std-ok")
}

-- mixedmod/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27

-- mixedmod/a/a.go --
package a

func A() int { return 1 }

-- mixedmod/b/b.lgo --
package b

func B() int { return 2 }

-- ws/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./gomod
	./lgomod
)

-- ws/gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gws

go 1.27

-- ws/gomod/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("go-ok")
}

-- ws/lgomod/go.mod --
module example.com/lws

go 1.27

-- ws/lgomod/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("lgo-ok")
}
